resources.string: Remind the agent to actually act

Off by default. Only for this conversation. When your request clearly asks for real work (fix, build, run, deploy, write code…) and the reply is only a plan with no tool call, one internal notice asks it to do the shortest next step now. Your goal and existing permissions do not change: no new \"continue\" message, no new chat, no tool replay, and the step limit is never raised.

Heuristic, not a mind reader: it may misjudge, so it ignores chit-chat, short answers, creative writing, missing permissions, requests for more information and explicit refusals. It can add model steps, but only inside the normal step budget. No extra review request is sent.
1 to 3, default 1. Counted per reply and kept after the conversation is reloaded.
Acknowledges the work so far and asks for the shortest real next step. Never shames the model.
States only the current state and the next step, without encouragement.
Appended to the default wording. Empty uses the default.
